messages:
Jordan: FYI — incident bot created a PIR for INC-2026-033. Need someone to steward and a list of core attendees. Proposed window: Thu Apr 17 10:00 PDT / 17:00 UTC (45m). Volunteers?

incident-bot: PIR created for INC-2026-033
Pre-read template: https://redwood.share/pir-templates/inc-2026-033
Suggested duration: 45m
Suggested attendees: oncall-sre, eng-search, cust-success

Alex: I can steward but prefer Thu morning. Thu 10:00 PDT works for me. happy to run through pre-read.

Priya: I can attend Thu. Can someone confirm customer impact owner? @Sofia?

Sofia: Confirmed — customer impact was Search Indexing (partial). I'll give customer-impact segment and bring logs. Thu 10:00 OK.

Kai: +1 Thu, I'll bring the latency + error-rate graphs and the Redis traces.

Jordan: Great. Alex will steward if no objections. @Priya can you own the action tracker during the PIR (create spreadsheet + link to the ticket list)? We should also invite the Dedicated infra PM for capacity discussion.

Priya: Yep I'll own the tracker. I'll make a sheet and add the initial actions before the meeting.

Alex: I'll steward. Please add the following to agenda:
- timeline and impact (Sofia)
- mitigation steps (oncall)
- RCA hypotheses (SRE)
- action assignment & owners

Alex (continued): I'll run the readout. @incident-bot please create calendar invite for Thu Apr 17 10:00 PDT and include attendees: Alex, Priya, Sofia, Kai, Jordan, oncall-sre, pm-dedicated.

incident-bot: Calendar invite created: Thu Apr 17 10:00 PDT (45m)
Invitees: Alex, Priya, Sofia, Kai, Jordan, oncall-sre, pm-dedicated
Pre-read: https://redwood.share/pir-templates/inc-2026-033
Meeting link: https://meet.redwood/INC-2026-033-PIR

Jordan: Thanks all. Action: Priya will post the tracker here when ready. Alex to run the PIR. Close loop on remediation items within 2 weeks. :thumbsup: 

Priya: Posted tracker: https://docs.redwood/actions/inc-2026-033
I'll add owners + due dates by EOD.
